grok.pulse: Wall Street closed with its best day in months (S&P +2.3-2.4%, Nasdaq +2.7%) as oil plunged 4-6% on Trump's comments that new Iran strikes are highly unlikely if talks progress, easing inflation fears and driving a broad rebound including chips ex-NVDA after last week's AI selloff.
grok.bias: risk-on — oil collapse and Iran de-escalation hopes reduced inflation and geopolitical risk, fueling equity and AI/chip recovery (AMD +13%, SOX strong) ahead of CPI, despite ~80% Dec FOMC hike odds and NVDA lag on CEO probe.

@Kalshi_Finance (~8:03 PM ET): Insane day — S&P best since April, Nasdaq best since July; all 11 sectors green; WTI -4.4% to $86.85, Brent -5.9%; Dec hike odds ~82%; Mag7 ripped except NVDA -4.3%

grok.trump: Told media (CNN/60 Minutes) that fresh US strikes on Iran are highly unlikely if negotiations show progress; after meeting Qatar PM, described the conflict as militarily effectively over with status quo continuing and US ready if needed.
